plain.compression: none by default; explicit compression writes compressed bytes

custom.compression: compressed by default; supports configured compression except tar restriction does not apply

directory.compression: compressed by default; --file target directory is required and created by pg_dump

16-18.numericShorthand: level>0 means gzip; level=0 means none
notes: PostgreSQL common compression parsing knows a workers detail, but pg_dump currently warns that compression workers are not supported; PgCliSharp therefore does not expose it as a typed pg_dump setting.
gzip accepts explicit level -1 (library default) or 1..9; LZ4 accepts 0..12; zstd bounds depend on the linked zstd library and are validated by the executable.

environments.inherited: pg_dump also consumes environment variables supported by libpq; passwords should use libpq mechanisms such as a password file rather than a command-line password value

io.stdout: Always treat as bytes. Custom/tar archives and compressed plain output are binary; do not decode stdout in the core execution API.
io.file: When --file is present pg_dump writes the file itself; stdout should not be treated as the dump payload.
io.directory: Requires --file target directory; cannot stream the archive through stdout.
io.stdin: PostgreSQL 17+ --filter=- consumes stdin, therefore the process abstraction needs binary-safe stdin piping as well as stdout piping.

designDecisions.noRawArguments: No arbitrary raw command-line string in the normal public API.
designDecisions.repeatables: Use ordered collections and emit one command-line option per collection item.
designDecisions.output: Output destination is a dedicated API, not an overloaded string; stdout streams remain binary-safe.
designDecisions.versionValidation: Probe --version before execution. Use actual parsed numeric executable version for patch-dependent availability such as --restrict-key.

inventoryVerification.method: Compared every version's resolved long-option spelling set against the official REL_10_STABLE through REL_18_STABLE src/bin/pg_dump/pg_dump.c long_options table.
inventoryVerification.result: Exact match for PostgreSQL 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, and 18 after applying per-spelling availability.

apiCoverageVerification.result: All 75 inventory entries have an explicit public-API or wrapper binding.

specialBindings.file: PgDumpOutput models stdout/file/directory destination rather than PgDumpOptions.
specialBindings.help: Help is a utility command and is intentionally not part of normal PgDumpOptions execution.

apiCoverageVerification.argumentGeneration: Every spec entry mapped to a PgDumpOptions property is represented by the deterministic argument builder; output/version/help use the special bindings above.

commandSyntax.databaseArgument: The database can be supplied by -d/--dbname or the positional dbname form upstream. PgCliSharp uses the typed Database property and emits --dbname. If omitted, libpq environment/default resolution applies.
commandSyntax.optionArguments: All pg_dump options in PostgreSQL 10-18 either take no argument or a required argument; this inventory records that explicitly in argumentMode.
